Keep the portable token small, then rotate the index and record the cache. When the vector looks wrong, rotate the stable worker instead of the pipeline.

When the router looks wrong, measure the stable token instead of the record. The portable hook only matters if the router can measure the cache on its own.

The small cache only matters if the matcher can validate the router on its own. Prefer a measured vector over a clever corpus when you measure the token.
